list.title: Workflows
list.description: Step-by-step automations that start on their own: webhooks, schedules, emails, files and connector events. Every workflow is code (workflow.py).

empty.title: No workflows yet
empty.description: Create a workflow to chain agents, model calls, tools and human approvals.

list.deleteDescription: Its code, canvas and triggers are removed. Saved versions stay in the repository history.

create.title: New workflow
create.description: Pick a starting point; you can change everything on the canvas.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. It is the name of its folder in workforce/.
create.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter
create.nameTaken: A member with that name already exists in the project

blank.label: Blank
blank.description: Input and output, to start from scratch.

approval.label: With approval
approval.description: Prepares a request, asks for human approval and returns the result.

classify.label: Classify and branch
classify.description: A model classifies the input and a condition picks the output.

notFound.title: This workflow does not exist
notFound.description: We could not find “{name}” in this project.

builder.codeSaved: Code saved; the canvas is in sync
builder.codeSavedCodeMode: Code saved. The workflow is in code mode: the code wins
builder.fixErrors: Fix the issues marked on the canvas before saving
builder.leaveDescription: This workflow has unsaved changes. If you leave now they will be lost.

canvas.label: Workflow canvas
canvas.dragHint: Drag a node onto the canvas or click to add it.
canvas.empty: Drag nodes from the palette to start
canvas.copied: {count, plural, one {# node copied} other {# nodes copied}}
canvas.dropFailed: The node could not be added
canvas.inputUnique: The workflow already has an input node
canvas.connectSelf: A node cannot connect to itself
canvas.connectInput: The input node does not accept incoming connections
canvas.cycleRejected: That connection would create a cycle. Use a Loop node to repeat steps

issues.title: Workflow issues
issues.count: {n, plural, one {# issue to fix} other {# issues to fix}}

canvas.codeModeDescription: workflow.py was edited by hand and no longer matches the canvas. This is the graph the engine reads from the code; edit it in the Code tab.
canvas.codeDirty: You have unsaved code changes; save or discard them to edit the canvas.
canvas.readOnlyViewer: Your role can only view the workflow.
canvas.flowUnavailable: The graph could not be read from the code
canvas.flowEmpty: The runtime did not return the graph. Check the code and try again.

input.label: Input
input.description: The workflow inputs and the trigger event ('{{'event'}}').

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Calls an agent of the project with a message (with its tools and approvals).

llm.label: Model call
llm.description: A single model call with a prompt; it can return JSON.

tool.label: Tool
tool.description: A built-in tool: send email, read URL, calculator…

connector_action.label: Connector action
connector_action.description: An action of a connected app (Gmail, CRM, database…).

knowledge_search.label: Knowledge search
knowledge_search.description: Searches knowledge bases and returns passages with their source.

sql_query.label: SQL query
sql_query.description: A read-only SELECT over a knowledge base's tables.

http_request.label: HTTP request
http_request.description: Calls an external API. Anything but GET asks for approval.

condition.label: Condition
condition.description: Evaluates an expression and follows the “yes” or “no” branch.

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: Repeats a node for every item of a list or a number of times.

transform.label: Transform
transform.description: Builds a text or a JSON from other nodes, without code.

approval.label: Human approval
approval.description: Pauses the workflow until someone with the given role approves (or corrects) the data.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Waits a few seconds before continuing.

sub_workflow.label: Sub-workflow
sub_workflow.description: Runs another workflow of the project with some inputs.

panel.title: Node settings
panel.selectHint: Select a node to configure it. Connect nodes by dragging from their right handle.
panel.label: Display name
panel.idHint: Used in '{{'id.output'}}' bindings. Renaming it updates the bindings.
panel.idInvalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter (not input, event or item)
panel.idTaken: There is already a node with that identifier
panel.deleteDescription: Its connections are removed too. You can undo it with ⌘Z before saving.
panel.approverRoleHint: This role or a higher one gets the request in Approvals and by email.
panel.approvalForced: This tool always asks for approval before running.
panel.noAgents: This project has no agents yet.
panel.agentPromptHint: The message the agent receives. Use bindings to include data from other nodes.
panel.systemHint: Fixed text; bindings go in the prompt.
panel.sqlHint: A single SELECT statement. Pass values as $1, $2… parameters (never inside the SQL).
panel.httpApproval: Requests other than GET pause until someone approves them.
panel.headersHint: Fixed values. For project secrets write $NAME (for example: Bearer $API_TOKEN).
panel.expressionHint: Comparisons (==, !=, >, <, >=, <=), and, or, not, in and functions len, lower, upper, empty… over bindings. E.g. '{{'input_node.output.amount'}}' > 1000 and '{{'input.country'}}' in ["ES", "PT"]
panel.loopForeach: For every item of a list
panel.itemsHint: A binding to a list, for example '{{'query.output.rows'}}'.
panel.loopBodyHint: Inside the repeated node use '{{'{id}.item'}}' and '{{'{id}.index'}}'. You can also connect it from the loop's bottom handle.
panel.maxItemsHint: If the list is longer, the node fails (maximum {max}).
panel.transformHint: A text with bindings or a JSON whose values can be bindings.
panel.outputHint: What the workflow returns. If several outputs run, the last one wins.
panel.approvalPromptHint: Shown in the Approvals inbox and in the email.
panel.payloadHint: The approver can correct it; the following nodes get the approved values in '{{'id.output'}}'.
panel.waitHint: At most {max} s: a run has a time limit. For long waits use a scheduled trigger.
panel.noWorkflows: There are no other workflows in this project.
panel.noKnowledgeBases: The organization has no knowledge bases.
panel.allowedHostsHint: Optional, comma separated. Empty: any public domain.
panel.sideEffect: This action changes data in the connected app; it asks for approval by default.

bindings.empty: No values available: connect previous nodes

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.hint: What a manual run asks for. Triggers fill them with their fixed inputs and add the event.
inputs.name: Input name
inputs.invalidName: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter

issues.duplicateInput: Some inputs have the same name
issues.inputCount: The workflow needs exactly one input node
issues.noOutput: The workflow needs at least one output node
issues.edgeIntoInput: The input node cannot have incoming connections
issues.edgeFromOutput: An output node cannot have outgoing connections
issues.unlabeledBranch: A condition's connections must be “yes” or “no”
issues.loopBody: Choose the node the loop repeats
issues.loopBodyShared: “{id}” is already the body of another loop
issues.loopBodyType: That type of node cannot be repeated inside a loop
issues.loopBodyEdge: Connect the loop with the node it repeats
issues.loopBodyConnections: A loop body only connects with its loop
issues.loopItems: Set the list the loop iterates over
issues.disconnected: This node is not connected to the workflow
issues.bindingLoop: Inside the loop use .item or .index of “{id}”
issues.bindingBody: “{id}” repeats inside a loop: use the loop's output
issues.bindingUpstream: “{id}” does not come before this node ({binding})
issues.unknownAgent: The agent “{name}” does not exist in this project
issues.systemBindings: System instructions do not accept bindings
issues.invalidModel: The model must look like provider/model
issues.unknownTool: The tool “{name}” is not available in workflows
issues.invalidKey: “{key}” is not a valid field name
issues.sqlBindings: Do not put bindings inside the SQL: use $1, $2… parameters
issues.invalidUrl: The URL must start with https://
issues.expressionName: Unknown name in the condition: {name}. Use bindings to nodes or inputs
issues.waitRange: The wait must be between 1 and {max} seconds
issues.unknownWorkflow: The workflow “{name}” does not exist in this project
issues.unknownFunction: The function “{name}” does not exist in nodes.py

run.title: Run
run.unsavedHint: You have unsaved changes: the last saved version runs.
run.sampleEventHint: Simulates a trigger event ('{{'event'}}'), for example a webhook body.
run.viewerHint: You need the builder role to run workflows.
run.idleHint: Fill in the inputs and run: you will see each node's status on the canvas.

code.codeModeBanner: workflow.py no longer matches the canvas: the code wins. If you go back to the structure the Studio generates, the canvas syncs on save.
code.syncHint: This is the code that runs. If you only change texts and values, the canvas updates on save; any other change turns on code mode.
code.graphDirty: You have unsaved canvas changes; save or discard them to edit the code.
code.viewer: Your role can only view the code.

custom.hint: Every public function of nodes.py appears in the palette. It receives the node's arguments and returns a JSON value.

empty.title: No functions
empty.description: Add a function to use it as a custom node.

custom.removeDescription: It is removed from nodes.py and from the palette.
custom.newDescription: It is appended to nodes.py with a skeleton to complete.
custom.name: Function name
custom.nameInvalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter

presets.monthly: On the 1st of every month at 9:00

cron.syntax: Each field accepts * (all), numbers, ranges (1-5), lists (1,15) and steps (*/10). Weekday: 0 or 7 = Sunday.
cron.invalid: Some fields of the expression are not valid

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: How this workflow starts on its own. Every firing creates a run with '{{'event'}}' and the fixed inputs.

empty.title: No triggers
empty.description: Add a webhook, a schedule, an inbound email or a connector event.

cron.label: Scheduled
cron.description: On a schedule (cron) in your time zone.

webhook.label: Webhook
webhook.description: A unique URL with a secret and a signature.

email.label: Inbound email
email.description: A unique address for this workflow.

file.label: File uploaded
file.description: When a file is uploaded to a knowledge base.

triggers.dialogDescription: The workflow gets the event in '{{'event'}}' and the fixed inputs as inputs.
triggers.environmentHint: Development runs the latest saved code; production, the deployed version.
triggers.staticInputHint: Passed on every firing, together with the event.
triggers.webhookHint: After creating it you will see the URL and the secret (only once). Requests must be signed with HMAC-SHA256.
triggers.emailHint: Creating it generates a unique address. Every email sent to it fires the workflow.
triggers.manualHint: Run it from this tab or from the run panel.
triggers.noKnowledgeBases: The organization has no knowledge bases.
triggers.fileHint: The event includes the file's name and identifier.
triggers.eventHint: The connector event name (for example gmail.new_email) or * for all.
triggers.fired: Run queued; it will appear in the history in a few seconds
triggers.rotateDescription: The current secret stops working immediately: update whoever sends the requests with the new one.
triggers.deleteDescription: The workflow will no longer fire this way. Past runs are kept.
triggers.failures: {n, plural, one {# failure in a row} other {# failures in a row}}
triggers.fileOn: When a file is uploaded to {kb}
triggers.signatureRecipe: Sign every request with the X-Messer-Signature header: t=UNIX_TIME,v1=SIGNATURE, where SIGNATURE is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of “UNIX_TIME.body” with the secret. Five minutes of clock skew are accepted; X-Messer-Event-Id prevents duplicates.
triggers.curlSecret: the secret shown when the webhook was created
triggers.curlBody: the JSON the workflow gets in event.body
triggers.secretDescription: Copy the secret now: it will not be shown again.
triggers.secretOnce: Keep the secret somewhere safe. If you lose it, rotate it.
triggers.testEmailDescription: Simulates an email to {address} without an inbound provider.
triggers.emailNotRouted: The email did not fire any workflow (is the trigger disabled?)
